content.short: STARK offers scalable, secure, and efficient Transparent Argument of Knowledge proofs.
content.description: zk-STARKs are cryptographic proofs that safeguard the privacy and integrity of blockchain computations. Introduced in 2018, they use advanced algebra to enable blockchains to delegate computations to an off-chain prover and verify the results on-chain with a STARK verifier. This approach blends strong security with operational efficiency, helping blockchains perform complex tasks more securely and efficiently. The technique supports scalable, trust-minimized verification while reducing on-chain workload.
